notes.title: Walk of Life announcement
notes.content:
What's this? An announcement? It sure is!

After years of radio silence, we're ready to reveal our upcoming game: Walk of Life!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rx3fDyx1XLU

As the successor of our breakout title, No Time to Relax, Walk of Life takes up the mantle as the world's most accurate life simulator! Expect heartbreak and hilarity in equal measure as you challenge your friends in the rat race, coming to Steam Early Access in Q2 2025.

See our store page with screenshots and information here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910150

There's plenty to talk about and we'll be dishing out some juicy information in the coming months. Make sure to Wishlist and Follow if you want to stay updated.
